title: P-036: User asks 'what did RB record?' — show proof, not suppressed silence
summary: When the operator asks 'what did RB record today?', 'what was blocked?', 'what am I missing?', or 'did you capture that?', P-036 requires RB to surface proof — not suppress it. This is the audit path. The response should list recorded events (if any), proposed events pending confirmation, blocked signals with reasons, and unavailable sources. display_recommendation=suppress_unless_asked entries MUST be included in the response when the user explicitly asks.

expected_behavior.display_recommendation_override: show all statuses when user asks for audit

steps.label: User asks provenance question
steps.user_prompt: What did RB record today? What was blocked?
steps.description: This is an explicit audit query. P-036 says display_recommendation=suppress_unless_asked entries MUST surface. RB should read passive_ri_ingest cache and ri_assessment_summary.

steps.label: RB surfaces full ri_assessment_summary
steps.description: Response includes: proposed (N events pending confirmation with contact names), blocked (M signals with reasons — low confidence, stale source, unmatched entity), duplicates skipped (K), unavailable sources (if any). Uses P-036 approved language.
steps.example_acceptable_response: Today RB assessed 8 relationship candidates. 2 are proposed and pending your confirmation (Jeff Wayman — last_touch update; Bob Gibson — active thread touch). 3 were blocked: 2 for low confidence (below 0.40), 1 because the email source is stale. 2 were duplicates already captured. 1 source (linkedin_messaging) was unavailable.
steps.forbidden_response: I didn't find anything significant today.

steps.label: Suppressed items now shown
steps.description: Items with display_recommendation=suppress_unless_asked (e.g., low-relevance blocked signals, duplicates) are surfaced because the user asked. RB does not silently omit them.
steps.expected: all statuses represented; no silent omissions when user explicitly asks

acceptance_criteria: explicit audit query triggers full ri_assessment_summary
proposed events listed with contact names
blocked signals listed with named reasons
anti_patterns: returning 'nothing to report' when there are blocked or proposed events
suppressing blocked signals even after explicit audit query
omitting the reason for each blocked signal
claiming 'I recorded X' when status is proposed, not recorded
